It appears as a smudge of purple/pink rather than a coherent hand or wand. This suggests either extreme depth-of-field issues or AI generation failure in rendering complex foreground interactions.

The boundary between the bubble and the background is slightly soft and 'bleeds' into the background more than a sharp optical edge would, likely due to the generative model's handling of translucent layers.

The distortion of the background through the bubble is generally correct but lacks the precise chromatic aberration and sharpness changes expected from a real lens focusing through a curved liquid surface. It looks slightly 'painted' rather than optically refracted.
